errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_APPROVAL_MISSING: Required explicit human approval is absent or invalid.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_ATTESTATION_FAILED: Cryptographic artifact attestation did not verify.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_BINDING_MISMATCH: Evidence does not bind the exact artifact identity and digest.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_DOWNGRADE: A lifecycle generation downgrade was attempted.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: One or more mandatory evidence fields are absent.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_EVIDENCE_STALE: Evidence or its checkpoint is outside the authorized freshness window.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_EXTERNAL_CHECKPOINT_: No verified external immutable checkpoint is available.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_INDEPENDENCE_UNKNOWN: Witness independence is unknown or below threshold.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_INTEGRITY_FAILURE: Stored lifecycle evidence failed integrity validation.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_LOCK_INCOMPLETE: The lock and approved artifact manifest do not have identical coverage.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_LOCK_MALFORMED: The platform lock is unpinned, unhashed, ambiguous, or malformed.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_MODEL_AUTHORITY_FORB: A model or provider attempted to supply an authority decision.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_PLATFORM_MISMATCH: Artifact or lock platform identity does not match policy.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_POLICY_INACTIVE: The human-governed policy is absent, malformed, draft, or revoked.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_PROVENANCE_NOT_PROVE: Provenance is PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, FAILED, or unavailable.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_REPLAY: Evidence, approval, or lifecycle material has already been consumed.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_REVOKED: The artifact authorization or governing policy has been revoked.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_STORE_TIMEOUT: The append-only store could not complete atomically before timeout.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_STORE_UNAVAILABLE: The append-only store is unavailable or returned an ambiguous result.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_SUBSTITUTION: Project, source, signer, workflow, or artifact substitution was detected.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_SUPERSESSION_REQUIRE: Replacement requires explicit lineage to the active record.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_TRANSPARENCY_FAILED: Transparency-log inclusion or checkpoint verification failed.
errors.DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_UNAUTHORIZED_PLATFOR: Logical lock parity differs without an approved exception.
